study: Delivered telemetry and outage-aware warehouse control
training: Reuse frozen checkpoints; no new training or threshold fitting
conditions: Even site IDs are stationary; odd IDs have the previously declared hidden drift process
development_selection: Select one shared outage-aware horizon by lowest total control misses across BOTH models on the four development sites, breaking ties by greater aggregate bulk throughput, then shorter horizon
telemetry: Initial sixty-second history is a shared conditional warm start. Subsequently only actual cadence-triggered scans produce reports: top eight noisy RSSI entries above -90 dBm, including the same hidden fading and blockage as packet transmission. A report finishes after the charged scan outage and is piggybacked inside a successful existing 600-byte control frame (at most 128 bytes reserved; application payload reduced accordingly). No successful control delivery means no report arrival. Latest report replaces any pending older report. Predictors receive only strictly past delivery bins, with original measurement positions. Missing scans are not censored readings. Motion/route/pose remain out-of-band public inputs, as before.
ideal_reference: Previously used five-second periodic capped scans, independent of native outages; old native candidate scoring plus all-handover outage admission. Only this explicitly named reference uses the old ideal stream.
delivered_reference: Same old scoring/admission with the new delivered telemetry
utility: Minimise the integral of the frozen NIST-derived three-retry failure surrogate plus actual handover outage over the selected horizon. Integrate from the exact fractional outage endpoint. Check both planned and reactive proposals. This is a heuristic surrogate, not a calibrated deadline probability or safety guarantee.
timing: One FIFO server. Full single-family prediction costs measured and sealed on prior validation seed 301000 before development; use the greater of new and previous cadence-five p95 cost for cold/warm/refit, plus 500 ms. Results become visible only after completion and are advanced by their age.
primary: Paired-site control-miss ppm difference: distilled delivered_utility minus distilled delivered_reports at four-second handover cost on eight untouched seeds; success only if the upper endpoint of a 20,000-resample paired-site 95% bootstrap interval is below zero
secondary: Model comparison at equal delivered sensing/controller settings; fast-handover sensitivity; forecast errors, report delivery/age, misses by cause, bulk/video throughput and safety-stop proxies
disjointness: New development/test seeds must not appear in any previous study protocol
